## FM27 Tactical Bible 5.3.0

**HTML5 Canvas 2D pitch engine, smooth animations across every role and instruction, visual Bible concepts, and live squad refresh.**

- **HTML5 `<canvas>` 2D pitch & `ui-sdk` controls**: Replaced the SVG pitch simulator and Bible clips with a HiDPI 2D canvas renderer (lofted ball arcs with ground shadows, player facing chevrons, pulsing press rings, motion trails, click-to-follow hit-testing, and off-screen pausing) plus accessible `ui-sdk` web component controls.
- **Accurate, smooth tactical animations**: Overhauled all 77 IP/OOP role clips and 23 team instruction comparisons with continuous ball ownership, synced ball carries, and clean loop resets (no backwards ball teleports). Fixed **Final Third Patience** to match FM27's actual options (**Hit Early Crosses** / **Balanced** / **Work Ball Into Box**).
- **Bible › Concepts, Principles & Opponents visuals**: Added 8 animated concept clips, 2 inline FM27 diagrams (Complexity tiers & Tactical Effectiveness pillars), and 6 opponent matchup clips.
- **Live Squad Refresh via FM27 Bridge**: Refresh your active squad directly from running FM27 in *Team › Squad* and *Tactic › Generator*.

### Installation
Download `…setup.exe` (installer) or `FM27-Tactical-Bible-portatil.exe` (runs without installing).
